brief: Volume Hiring Challenge: we're opening a new support floor and need 5 Customer Support Associates — fast.
30 candidates. 3 minutes. Hire 5, and 🚩 flag every red flag you see. Only red-flag accuracy counts.

cards.name: Aisha Khan
cards.title: Customer Support Associate, Callnest
cards.summary: 18 months handling billing queries; CSAT 4.6/5 on 9k tickets.
cards.interview_line: “I log every escalation with the root cause so the next agent doesn't repeat it.”

cards.name: Rohit Yadav
cards.title: Team Lead, Callnest & Team Lead, Hellodesk (2029–2031)
cards.summary: Lists two full-time team-lead roles at the same time in 2029–2031.
cards.interview_line: “I managed both teams together.”

flags.explanation: Two simultaneous full-time team-lead jobs at competing BPOs — dates overlap completely.

cards.name: Pooja Sharma
cards.title: Chat Support Executive, Quickfix Home
cards.summary: 1 year chat support, average handle time 6 min, top 10% QA scores.
cards.interview_line: “If I can't solve it in chat, I tell the customer exactly when they'll hear back.”

cards.name: Imran Sheikh
cards.title: Fresher, B.Com 2030
cards.summary: Final-year project on customer churn; volunteered at a helpline.
cards.interview_line: “At the helpline I learnt to listen first and summarise back.”

cards.name: Deepika Rao
cards.title: Customer Success Ninja
cards.summary: CX, NPS, CSAT, AHT, FCR, QA, WFM, CRM, SLA, omnichannel, AI chatbots, Six Sigma.
cards.interview_line: “I'm passionate about customer delight and synergies.”

flags.explanation: CV is a list of metrics acronyms with no actual numbers or employers.

cards.name: Suresh Gowda
cards.title: Telecaller, Kiranmart
cards.summary: 2 years outbound + inbound; promoted to buddy trainer.
cards.interview_line: “I trained 6 new joiners on our call script last quarter.”

cards.name: Neha Gupta
cards.title: Bilingual Support (English/French)
cards.summary: Claims fluent French for EU support queue.
cards.interview_line: (Asked a French question) “Sorry, can we continue in English?”

flags.explanation: Claims C1 French for a French queue but couldn't answer a basic question in French.

cards.name: Tenzin Dorje
cards.title: Retail Associate, Trendloop
cards.summary: Store floor sales, 3 years; handles returns and complaints.
cards.interview_line: “Angry customers mostly want to be heard — then fixed.”

cards.name: Ritu Singh
cards.title: Support Associate, Ridewise
cards.summary: Ride-hailing driver support, night shifts, 14 months.
cards.interview_line: “Night shift is fine for me — I've done it for over a year.”
